completion_summary: Gate-8 flake eliminated: 0 findings attributable to this task across 20 consecutive verify-deploy.sh runs (was 4/20). Root cause was test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh's real-process liveness assertion; fixed via an injectable _pid_is_alive seam in claude-refresh.sh plus a deterministic scripted probe. Poll-budget widening was disproven, not adopted. Standing deploy drift, an index-entries line_count mismatch, and a dangling state.json dependency were also cleared. One residual remains and is deliberately unfixed: a pre-existing, out-of-scope literature index-entries line_count mismatch (117 vs 144) present in all 20 runs and belonging to a concurrent effort.
